اغتصبتن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَصَبْتُنَّ (iḡtaṣabtunna) /iɣ.ta.sˤab.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# اُغْتُصِبْتُنَّ (uḡtuṣibtunna) /uɣ.tu.sˤib.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
